# Page fixtures

`skewed-two-column.png`: a synthetic US Letter page at 300 dpi, rotated 4 degrees clockwise, a title over two columns of text
(38 and 12 lines) set in Liberation Serif and Sans (SIL OFL). The text is written for this fixture. `skewed-two-column.txt` holds
the lines in reading order: the title, the first column, then the second. CC0.

`tools/skew_pages.py` makes pages of the same kind in other layouts, angles and fonts, with their truth words.
